The one dish

Cooked slow.
Served fast, all night.

Nihari means “morning” — traditionally eaten at dawn after a night of slow cooking. At Muhammadi, that tradition never closes. The pot is always on.

Signature Beef Nihari

Rich, glossy gravy with deep spice, tender beef that falls apart, and the classic Lahori finish. Every bowl is garnished to order — never before.

In Mozang Chungi, Old Lahore

A name Lahore
already knows.

On Bahawalpur Road in Saadi Park, Mozang Chungi, Muhammadi Nehari House has built its reputation the old way — one pot, cooked slowly, served generously, at any hour. No shortcuts, no closing time. That is why nearly eight thousand people have reviewed it on Google.

Students at midnight, families at breakfast, travellers passing through Lahore at dawn — the door is open for all of them.

Plan Your Visit
Cooked overnight

Real nihari cannot be rushed. The gravy gets its body from hours of slow cooking, not shortcuts.

Open 24 hours

Breakfast at 6am or dinner at 2am — the famous 24-hour service is why Mozang never sleeps hungry.

Garnished to order

Ginger, chillies, coriander and lemon go on when you order, so every bowl tastes freshly finished.
